name: richos-local
description: The RichOS engine, served from a local checkout. One copy of the mechanical layer on disk; every adopting repository loads it by reference rather than carrying a hand-ported duplicate.

plugins.name: richos-engine
plugins.description: The RichOS engine as a loadable plugin: the orchestration guards (worktree isolation, resume isolation, main-checkout write protection, secret scanning, definition-drift detection, durable handoff logging), the shipped skills, and the four meta-roles every operator needs regardless of what they build.
